changes.body: Build and install qlock from its own repository. Merge queues use Git directly and no longer require Honeycomb. Queue behavior, SQLite storage and existing lock paths are unchanged.

adoption.text: Install with Homebrew or build from source. Read README.md for installation commands; no project setup is required.

changes.summary: show queue tool release changes without joining a queue
changes.body:
Run `qlock changelog` for bundled release history and adoption instructions.
Version selection and paginated JSON output work without acquiring a lock.

changes.summary: Help explains queue admission timeouts and how to resume a retained ticket.
